public_hook_direction: Two adults. One cooker. No reliable witness.
reader_identity_mirror: Any couple who has jointly lost count of a tiny domestic task can send this as an identity mirror.
emotional_obstacle: Neither partner is fully sure, but the home needs a decision and both want to look like functioning adults.
aachu_proof: She runs the evidence room: whistle count, finger math, dramatic eye contact, and a confident-but-not-confident verdict.
zuv_active_role: He controls the flame, checks his own count, meets her doubt, and joins the shared uncertainty instead of standing outside it.
bridge: The joke starts as kitchen confusion and turns into the private comfort of not having to be competent alone.
earned_ending: The home feels like theirs because both can be wrong, laugh, and still decide together.
send_save_reason: The seeti-count premise is instantly Indian, specific, and taggable without private Aachu/Zuv context.
